title: Alchemical Distillation Chess Laboratory
description: A virtual alchemy lab where chess pieces (ABeautifulGame) represent elemental reagents on a reaction mat (coffeemat), and the glass hurricane candle holder serves as a distillation vessel. Users drag reagent pieces into the vessel to combine elements, observing conservation of atomic mass while managing multi-step reactions with undo/redo support.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 (importmap with cdn.jsdelivr.net) implementing an alchemical distillation lab. Load ABeautifulGame.glb scaled to 0.4 and place it on the left; each chess piece represents a chemical element (assign H, O, C, N, S, Fe to 6 distinct pieces via userData). Load coffeemat.glb centered as the lab workbench surface. Load GlassHurricaneCandleHolder.glb scaled to 1.5 on the right as the distillation vessel; make it semi-transparent (opacity 0.35, glass material with transmission). Camera: PerspectiveCamera at (0,8,12) looking at origin, with OrbitControls limited to 20-70 degree polar range. Lighting: warm PointLight inside the vessel (orange, intensity 3), HemisphereLight for ambient, and a DirectionalLight with shadows. INTERACTIONS (10-14 steps): Users raycast-click chess pieces to select reagents (piece glows with emissive highlight). Drag up to 3 selected pieces onto the vessel drop zone. A floating HUD panel shows current element symbols and total atomic mass. When pieces are dropped in the vessel, particle effects (BufferGeometry sparks) animate inside the glass. Users click a REACT button to attempt synthesis — valid combinations (e.g., 2H+O=H2O, C+2O=CO2, Fe+S=FeS) produce a product label and color change in the vessel glow. Invalid combos flash red warning. CONSERVATION LAW: total atomic mass before must equal total after; display both values. Multi-input coupling: changing any reagent recalculates all outputs live. UNDO/REDO: maintain a state stack (max 20); Ctrl+Z undoes last reagent add/remove or reaction, Ctrl+Y redoes. Show undo/redo buttons in the HUD. After successful synthesis, the product floats above the vessel as 3D text (TextGeometry or sprite). A reset button clears the vessel. Track and display a reaction count and total mass processed. All UI uses HTML overlay divs styled with dark semi-transparent backgrounds and monospace font.
